summary: Two chambers agree on adding a drink but leave the session without settling who handles the returns.
realLife: In 1987 Oregon’s chambers passed different wine-cooler bills and could not reconcile disputes over franchises and handling fees.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: competing bill texts and conference result.

turns.what: Conferees settle the handling fee and send identical coverage language back for a vote.
turns.pulledBy: Both delegations accept the same fee and franchise language.
turns.writesBack: A common text returns to each chamber.

turns.what: Conferees fail to agree and retailers keep using the existing coverage list.
turns.pulledBy: One chamber retains a conflicting provision at adjournment.
turns.writesBack: The coverage list stays in force for the next shipment.
